mobilePolicies.onAttack: Existing shared attacker-declaration proc roll; skill names and full ordered component shapes are allow-listed, no independent duplicate callback
mobilePolicies.basicAttackScale: Nominal object attack power is used only for the documented basicAttackPercent, basicAttackMultiplier, and critical multiplier; the existing normal hit is not repeated
mobilePolicies.critical: A 5.25x tooltip critical applies only an additional 4.25x nominal base to the target because the normal hit already occurred
mobilePolicies.strength: TR-22 Jinbe's fixed 1250000 is applied; +17500 per hero strength is computed only when ConfigureSourceModelHeroStrengthProvider supplies a real nonnegative strength, otherwise deferred without an invented attribute
mobilePolicies.soldier: E-09's secondary 25% roll records one seven-second, per-owner soldier contribution; no source-backed combat rawcode exists to spawn a real selectable soldier. The 700000 magic and 10% current-HP explosive per soldier depend on the live count. Remove on expiry, owner removal, and lane changes
mobilePolicies.explosive: The common HP/armor ledger applies 5% maximum HP plus 6% missing HP twice to line enemies; E-09's previously registered 10% explosive amplification is consumed by explosive-school attacks using the strongest-source policy
mobilePolicies.legacy: LI-02 physical adds only the first documented 25000 rank increment to the 600000 base; 350% magical bonus uses that modeled base, no synthetic additional ranks
mobilePolicies.mixed: Separate magical, physical, fixed, and explosive components use existing damage and enemy-lane gates; unknown native timing, armor, immunity and final hit ordering remain unverified
mobilePolicies.parity: Logical offline mobile combat result model, not a claim of original JASS execution equivalence
